command.failure: GM / player: For the first action on its next turn, the creature must use a single action to do as you command. You can command the target to approach you, run away (as if it had the Fleeing condition), release what it's holding, drop Prone, or stand in place. It can't Delay or take any reactions until it has obeyed your command. The module doesn't enforce this; it reminds you until the effect ends.
